title: Černý Conjecture on Shortest Reset Words of Synchronizing Automata
exact_target: Does every synchronizing $n$-state deterministic automaton have a reset word of length at most $(n-1)^2$?

sources.citation: Mikhail V. Volkov, "List of Results on the Černý Conjecture and Reset Thresholds for Synchronizing Automata," arXiv:2508.15655 (2025, updated August 2026).
